_comment: Code Sandbox pod type — flavor-selectable IDE. SANDBOX_FLAVOR picks between code-server (VS Code in browser), claude-code (terminal CLI agent), and plain (just Ubuntu). Default startup binds to :8080 for code-server; for the other flavors :8080 serves a friendly landing page that points the user at the web terminal.
name: Code Sandbox
author: FuelBorn
description: Multi-flavor Ubuntu sandbox. Picks the IDE at deploy time: VS Code in browser (code-server), Claude Code CLI, or plain shell. Persistent /home/container, sudo, public HTTPS URL.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash set -e apt-get update >/dev/null apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates git sudo gnupg xz-utils >/dev/null mkdir -p /mnt/server cd /mnt/server FLAVOR="${SANDBOX_FLAVOR:-code-server}" echo "==> Code Sandbox install: flavor=$FLAVOR" # Optional first-boot repo clone — all flavors honour SANDBOX_GIT_REPO. if [ -n "${SANDBOX_GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then echo "==> Cloning $SANDBOX_GIT_REPO into workspace/" GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/true timeout 300 git -c credential.helper= -c http.lowSpeedLimit=1000 -c http.lowSpeedTime=20 clone --depth=1 "$SANDBOX_GIT_REPO" /mnt/server/workspace 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo "warning: git clone failed/timed out (private repo, bad URL, or network) — skipping; clone manually inside the pod" fi case "$FLAVOR" in code-server) echo "==> Installing code-server" curl -fsSL https://code-server.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --prefix=/mnt/server/.code-server-prefix --method=standalone # Fix the install-time /mnt/server symlinks so they resolve at runtime # after Wings rebases the volume to /home/container. find /mnt/server/.code-server-prefix -type l | while read l; do tgt=$(readlink "$l") case "$tgt" in /mnt/server/*) newtgt=${tgt/\/mnt\/server\//\/home\/container\/} ln -sfn "$newtgt" "$l" ;; esac done mkdir -p /mnt/server/.config/code-server cat > /mnt/server/.config/code-server/config.yaml < Installing Claude Code CLI" # Install into a known PREFIX that survives the /mnt/server -> /home/container handoff. export CLAUDE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/mnt/server/.claude-prefix mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_INSTALL_PREFIX" curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash || echo "warning: Claude Code install non-zero — user can re-run inside the pod" ;; plain) echo "==> Plain Ubuntu sandbox — no IDE preinstalled" ;; *) echo "==> Unknown SANDBOX_FLAVOR=$FLAVOR — falling back to plain" ;; esac # Drop a tiny landing page server we serve on :8080 for non-code-server # flavors so the public URL has *something* friendly to return. mkdir -p /mnt/server/.landing cat > /mnt/server/.landing/index.html < Code Sandbox · FuelBorn

FuelBorn Code Sandbox

This pod is running the $FLAVOR flavor.

Open the web terminal from the FuelBorn dashboard and start working. To install your own server here (Next.js, FastAPI, anything), bind it to 0.0.0.0:8080 and it'll replace this landing page on the public URL.

EOF echo '==> Writing startup wrapper /mnt/server/.start.sh' cat > /mnt/server/.start.sh <<'STARTSH' #!/bin/bash # FuelBorn code-sandbox runtime entrypoint. The egg sets SANDBOX_FLAVOR; we # branch from there. set -e export PATH=/home/container/.code-server-prefix/bin:/home/container/.claude-prefix/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH cd /home/container FLAVOR="${SANDBOX_FLAVOR:-code-server}" echo "==> Booting code-sandbox flavor=$FLAVOR" start_landing() { # Tiny static server for the non-code-server flavors so the public URL # returns something on :8080 until the user runs their own app. if [ -f /home/container/.landing/index.html ]; then cd /home/container/.landing exec python3 -m http.server 8080 fi exec sleep infinity } case "$FLAVOR" in code-server) echo "sandbox ready (code-server at :8080)" if [ ! -x /home/container/.code-server-prefix/bin/code-server ]; then echo "code-server not found — re-running installer" curl -fsSL https://code-server.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --prefix=/home/container/.code-server-prefix --method=standalone fi exec /home/container/.code-server-prefix/bin/code-server --bind-addr 0.0.0.0:8080 ;; claude-code) echo "sandbox ready (Claude Code — open the web terminal and run \`claude\`)" start_landing ;; plain) echo "sandbox ready (plain Ubuntu)" start_landing ;; *) echo "sandbox ready (unknown flavor=$FLAVOR — defaulting to plain)" start_landing ;; esac STARTSH chmod +x /mnt/server/.start.sh echo '==> Code Sandbox install complete'

variables.name: Sandbox flavor
variables.description: Which IDE flavor to provision: code-server (VS Code in browser), claude-code (terminal agent), or plain (just Ubuntu).

variables.name: code-server password
variables.description: Used to gate the VS Code editor at /. Only meaningful when SANDBOX_FLAVOR=code-server.

variables.name: Git repository to clone on first boot
variables.description: Optional. Cloned into /home/container/workspace on install. HTTPS URLs only.
